name: Bank Transaction
definition: Code of the underlying bank transaction.

Domain.name: Domain
Domain.definition: Specifies the business area of the underlying transaction.

Family.name: Family
Family.definition: Specifies the family within a domain.

SubFamily.name: Sub Family
SubFamily.definition: Specifies the sub-product family within a specific family.

ProprietaryIdentification.name: Proprietary Identification
ProprietaryIdentification.definition: Bank transaction code in a proprietary form, as defined by the issuer.

BankOperation.name: Bank Operation
BankOperation.definition: Bank operation for which a type is detailed.

RelatedEntry.name: Related Entry
RelatedEntry.definition: Entry for which a bank transaction code is provided.

RelatedPayment.name: Related Payment
RelatedPayment.definition: Payment for which bank transaction information is specified.
